contest.name: Hawaii QSO Party
contest.description: Annual Hawaii QSO Party, a 36-hour event starting the fourth Saturday of August (1600Z Saturday to 0400Z Monday). Hawaii stations work everyone for districts, states, provinces, and DXCC entities counted once. Non-Hawaii stations work Hawaii stations only, for the 14 Hawaii districts counted per band. CW, SSB, and digital.
contest.startDate: Fourth Saturday of August (2026: Aug 22 1600Z - Aug 24 0359Z)

userPrompts.question: Are you a Hawaii or non-HI station?

options.label: Non-Hawaii (US/VE/DX) - send RST + state/province, or DX

userPrompts.description: Hawaii stations work everyone. Non-Hawaii stations work Hawaii stations only. This answer also selects the multiplier scope: Hawaii stations count multipliers once for the contest, non-Hawaii stations count the 14 districts per band.

userPrompts.question: Enter your exchange: Hawaii district (3 letters), state/province (2 letters), or DX
userPrompts.description: 3-letter district abbreviation for Hawaii stations (never HI); 2-letter state/province for US/VE; the literal DX for stations outside the US/Canada. If operating remotely, send the QTH of the transmitting radio, not your home QTH.

userPrompts.description: Multi-operator entries are always multi-station. Cabrillo CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER records how many radios were operated at the same time.

multipliers.description: The multiplier SCOPE differs by station type, which is why stationClassMultTypes is used. Non-Hawaii stations: the 14 Hawaii districts counted PER BAND, maximum 84 (6 bands x 14 districts). Hawaii stations: 14 districts + 49 US states + DC + 13 Canadian provinces/territories + DXCC entities, counted ONCE for the contest, not per band. HI is never received as an exchange because Hawaii ops always send a district abbreviation, so it is not in the mult list. USA/Canada and Alaska/Hawaii are excluded from DXCC credit so a US or VE station counts only via its state/province and a Hawaii station only via its district.

dupeChecking.description: A station may be worked once per band per mode - three times per band, once each on CW, SSB, and digital. All digital modes (RTTY, PSK, FT8, FT4, VarAC, Winlink P2P, etc.) count as the single mode DIGITAL, so a station worked on RTTY may not be worked again on FT8 on the same band.

cabrillo.notes: CATEGORY-OPERATOR is SINGLE-OP or MULTI-OP only. CATEGORY-TRANSMITTER is the number of radios operated at the same time (ONE, TWO, ...). CATEGORY-BAND is ALL or a single band. The sent QTH must be the QTH of the transmitting radio - remote operators must give the remote radio's location in SOAPBOX and file a separate log per remote site.

callHistory.description: Save received exchange (district/state/province/DX) for future lookups

exchangeValidation.description: Hawaii district (3 letters), US state or DC (2 letters), Canadian province (2 letters), DX, or a 4-character grid square on digital modes. Validation is permissive because the rules explicitly allow a grid square when the mode cannot send a QTH name; a grid earns no multiplier in the app because a grid does not resolve to a single district - the sponsor's log checking assigns the most likely multiplier.
